   HOMŒOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA

           KOLA

         Kola-nut

        (STERCULIA)


Neurasthenia. Regulates the circulation, is tonic and anti-diarrheic,
        regulates cardiac rhythm and acts diuretically. Weak heart.


The remedy for the drinking habit. It promotes the appetite and
        digestion, and lessens the craving for liquor.   Asthma  .
        Gives power to endure prolonged physical exertion without taking food and without feeling
        fatigued.



Relationship.--    Coca  .



Dose.--  Three to ten drops, even one dram doses, three times a
        day.
